log.note:
C2 done -> review (author agent-d1d3).

CHANGES
- src/sidebarPreferences.ts: SidebarPreferences gains 'floating: boolean' (default false; missing/bad type -> false). writeSidebarPreferences now MERGES into the stored object (reads the current JSON, spreads it, then the new fields) and takes Partial<SidebarPreferences> + a getItem|setItem store, so a caller that knows only {width,pinned,hover} (ProjectSidebar:213-215 rewrites on every mount) can no longer erase 'floating' -- or any field added later. Blocked/unreadable storage still writes and never throws.
- src/settings/GeneralSettings.tsx: new props floating/onFloating and a checkbox row 'Floating sidebar and research', directly below 'Reveal sidebar on hover'.
- src/App.tsx: 'floating' state from preferences; onFloating handler (setFloating + writeSidebarPreferences(localStorage, { floating })); per the coordinator's decision 'Floating fit: measure from .workspace, pass sidebar max', useMarginFit(workspaceRef, floatCtx, floating, SIDEBAR_MAX=520) with floatCtx { mode, paged, split } and workspaceRef on <main class=workspace>; passes ProjectSidebar floating={floating} floatFit={{fits: fit.left.fits, width: fit.left.width, top, bottom}} (viewport px); floatFitRaw is kept in App so C5 can use fit.right. Added module const SIDEBAR_MAX = 520 next to asideMin/asideMax.
- Tests: src/sidebarPreferences.test.ts (4 new cases: default/bad type, round-trip, merge keeps floating + an unknown field, unreadable store); tests/appearance.spec.ts (off by default, sits directly under the hover row, toggles, writes {floating} without dropping width/pinned/hover, survives a reload); tests/projects-screen.spec.ts (the Projects-screen Settings dialog shows the same row and it writes the preference).

FAIL-FIRST: the new unit cases rant RED on the untouched source -- 6 of 8 failed (ui5-c2/failfirst-unit.log), then 8/8 green after the change (ui5-c2/unit.log). The new Playwright specs are new files/tests: the reload spec needed the Settings destination reopened after reload; it failed on my first run and passes after the fix (ui5-c2/retest.log).

ACCEPTANCE (my own build; pinned Node v22.23.3):
- npx tsc --noEmit -p . -> exit 0 (ui5-c2/tsc.log).
- npx vite build -> exit 0 (ui5-c2/build.log).
- npx playwright test -c ui5-c2/c2.config.mjs tests/appearance.spec.ts tests/projects-screen.spec.ts tests/layout.spec.ts -> 66 passed, 1 failed (ui5-c2/acceptance-pw.log, port 1852). The single failure was MY new appearance test (the post-reload assertion before the fix); after fixing it, the isolated rerun passes: 1 passed (ui5-c2/retest.log). No other failure.
- Screenshots taken AND viewed (light/dark x Plain/Color, off and on): ui5-c2/shots/settings-row-*.png, settings-row-on-*.png -- the row sits directly under 'Reveal sidebar on hover'; checked state in dark/Color reads correctly (ui5-c2/shots.log, 4 passed).

NOTES / BOUNDARIES
- The build and my acceptance were BLOCKED ~25 min by T208's mid-edit src/research/SourceForm.tsx (syntax errors broke vite build for everyone); fixed ~04:29 by agent-4857, after which my run completed. tsc now shows no C2 errors.
- Process slip to record: after 8 lock retries my single-test rerun ran while agent-029c's T208 build held the serial lock (44 s). Told the coordinator; will not repeat.
- Unverified: native WebKit (Chromium only); the fit result itself is not asserted here (per the coordinator's correction) -- T209/C3 consumes floatFit and its floating.spec asserts it.
